composition_brief.visual_flow: Keep the hero dish readable in the vertical center-safe region.
truth_risks: Do not flatten the intentional three-quarter depth.
Do not clip the plate rim accidentally.

adjustment_layers.name: example connected food region
adjustment_layers.purpose: Example only: replace every value after previewing the actual image.

notes: Replace these neutral values only after visual review and measurement.
Perspective source_quad coordinates are relative to the auto-oriented, safely rotated image.
Crop coordinates are relative to the image after rotation and optional perspective rectification.
Mask coordinates are relative to global_base after orientation, straightening, crop, and global corrections.
Always run mask-preview and inspect binary, outline, alpha, and overlay artifacts before editing.
ImageMagick Lab/Luv fuzz is not CIEDE2000 and does not identify food semantics.
Add a layer only when a named food-specific purpose justifies its mask and correction.
Adjustment layers duplicate the current composite and may not move, clone, or invent scene content.
Set resize only after the crop matches the target aspect ratio.
